senses.definition: doubtful word, ψ 7:1 (title), Ew De al. from √ שׁגה go astray, reel, i.e. wild, passionate song, with rapid changes of rhythm; cf. LagBN 201 f. who cp. שִׁגָּעוֹן, √ שׁגע; 𝔊 ψαλμός, read prob. מִזְמוֹר; pl. שִׁגְיֹנוֹת Hb 3:1 (title), read נְגִינוֹת, so 𝔊.
